scope: Finalize the six-area local-first implementation already merged into the current working head: bounded SCIP ingestion and session recall; optional official Gemini SDK adapter with deterministic fallback; reversible local hooks and optional dense retrieval; contract/docs hygiene; explicit authority disclosures; and expanded benchmark evidence. Preserve hosted/cloud/full-session non-goals and deterministic defaults.
non_goals: Hosted tenancy, billing, cloud synchronization, remote overlays, public distribution, enterprise isolation
Full SCM session product and latent development-state runtime
Direct model-driven filesystem writes or ChangeSet bypasses
Changing deterministic local defaults without benchmark evidence
Claiming compiler authority from heuristic/index-only data
risks: Official Gemini SDK dependency and API evolution
Filesystem hook mutation and rollback safety
SCIP ingestion path/root safety and malformed-input handling
Dense retrieval quality regressions or model identity drift
Large public-contract change requires cold fresh-eyes review
